verdict.rationale: Sketch supports Symbols and shared Styles/Libraries that propagate changes across designs, and AI features can swap light/dark component variants and generate color palettes, giving some token/mode-like behavior. However there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'variables' system with named color/spacing/typography tokens and mode-switching akin to Figma's Variables/modes — evidence only shows Symbols, Styles, and AI-driven light/dark swaps. missing for 10: explicit design-token/variables feature documentation, multi-mode theme switching UI, spacing/typography token support, independent hands-on confirmation of token workflows.
